config.maidaddon.title: Maid Addons
config.maidaddon.mining.max_vein.tooltip: Maximum number of blocks to break in a single chain operation
config.maidaddon.mining.range.tooltip: Radius around the maid to search for ores
config.maidaddon.mining.xray.tooltip: If enabled, maids will mine ores hidden behind walls. If disabled, they only mine visible ores.
config.maidaddon.mining.blacklist.toolti: List of block IDs to ignore
config.maidaddon.mining.whitelist.toolti: List of block IDs to FORCE mine, even if they aren't ores
config.maidaddon.mining.tool_break.toolt: If enabled, maids will use pickaxes until they break. If disabled, they stop at 1 durability.
config.maidaddon.mining.tier_check.toolt: If enabled, maid will only mine if her tool is strong enough to get drops.
config.maidaddon.logging.chop_placed_log: If enabled, maids will chop logs even if they don't have leaves connected
config.maidaddon.logging.auto_replant.to: If enabled, the maid will try to plant a matching sapling from her backpack
config.maidaddon.logging.tool_break.tool: If enabled, maids will use axes until they break. If disabled, they stop at 1 durability.
config.maidaddon.logging.blacklist.toolt: List of log IDs to ignore
config.maidaddon.logging.whitelist.toolt: List of block IDs to consider as logs
config.maidaddon.water.retrieve_delay.to: How long (in ticks) the water stays on the ground
config.maidaddon.water.fall_distance.too: The minimum distance (in blocks) the Master must fall before protection activates
config.maidaddon.water.lookahead.tooltip: How many blocks ahead to scan for the ground. Increase this if you hit the ground too early
If true, maid checks her inventory for potions. If false, only checks main/off hand.
config.maidaddon.alchemist.infinite.tool: If true, throwing a potion does NOT consume it.
config.maidaddon.alchemist.heal_threshol: Health percentage below which the maid throws healing potions.
config.maidaddon.alchemist.potion_self.t: If true, the maid will also throw potions at herself if she needs healing or buffs.
config.maidaddon.alchemist.throw_delay.t: Delay (in ticks) before throwing the potion (aiming time).
config.maidaddon.alchemist.throw_cooldow: Cooldown (in ticks) after throwing a potion before she can throw another.
config.maidaddon.alchemist.friendly_fire: Radius (in blocks) to check for friendly fire. Maid won't throw harmful potions if her owner is within this range of the target.
config.maidaddon.alchemist.throw_negativ: If true, throws harmful potions (Poison, Weakness, etc.) at enemies.
config.maidaddon.alchemist.throw_positiv: If true, throws beneficial potions (Strength, Speed, etc.) at Master/Self.
config.maidaddon.alchemist.heal_undead.t: If true, throws Healing Potions at Undead mobs to damage them.
config.maidaddon.organizing.sort_cooldow: Cooldown (in ticks) for a container after it has been sorted.
config.maidaddon.organizing.animation_ti: How long (in ticks) the sorting animation should last.
config.maidaddon.organizing.blacklist.to: List of container Block IDs to ignore (e.g., 'minecraft:chest').
config.maidaddon.fueling.furnace_cooldow: Cooldown (in ticks) for a furnace after it has been fueled.
config.maidaddon.fueling.algorithm.toolt: Algorithm to use for selecting fuel.
config.maidaddon.fueling.save_fuel.toolt: If true, maid will not use fuel if it would be wasted (e.g., using coal for one item).
config.maidaddon.fueling.use_inventory_f: If true, maid will search her inventory for fuel if she isn't holding any.
config.maidaddon.fueling.blacklist.toolt: List of fuel Item IDs to ignore (e.g., 'minecraft:coal').
List of item IDs to ignore when checking if a furnace needs fuel (e.g., 'minecraft:raw_iron').

task.maidaddon.alchemist.condition: Mainhand holds splash or lingering potion
